text:
leah_cs: FYI - Meridian wants to move their 12mo renewal to a 9mo to match their Q3 fiscal. Asking for a one-time credit and a shortened term. Their note: 'we can commit but need alignment on invoice timing'. PO link: https://meridian.purchases/PO-4732
omar_ae: Do we have pricing flexibility? what's the requested credit %?
diego_fin: Need the math. ARR is $120k. 9mo pro rata = $90k. If they ask for a 15% one-time credit that drops to $76.5k. Need approval from finance for >10% off. Also need vendor_code and invoice_entity.
leah_cs: They proposed 10% off and want invoice after signature, payments via ACH. They said vendor code will be on the PO.
nora_legal: If it's just term and amount, we can use our amendment template. If the PO references additional contract IDs, flag it. Also ask them to confirm billing entity (US vs. EU).
signbot: Signature request created AS-2040-11. Waiting on "finance_approved" and "vendor_code" fields.
omar_ae: I'll ping their procurement for vendor_code and confirm ACH + Net30.
diego_fin: ACH + Net30 is ok. If they request Net60 we escalate. Also confirm no currency change.
leah_cs: Action: (1) Omar get vendor_code and confirm payment terms (2) Diego pre-approve up to 10% credit (3) Nora prepare amendment doc (4) Leah attach PO to AdobeSign and send.
omar_ae: Replied to procurement@meridian.com for vendor_code; they responded "VC-9944" and attached the PO PDF. Forwarding.
diego_fin: With vendor_code VC-9944 and 10% credit we're within delegated approval. Marking finance_approved.
nora_legal: Drafted amendment (short form) and uploaded to Drive. No custom clauses. Ready for quick review: https://drive.redwood/amendments/meridian-9mo-draft
leah_cs: Sending AdobeSign now. Will attach PO and amendment. Anyone want to review before I send?
omar_ae: All good from my side.
diego_fin: go ahead.
signbot: AdobeSign envelope AS-2040-11 sent to customer at 2025-11-15T16:05Z. Envelope ID: env_0a9f
leah_cs: Thanks team. I'll close the loop when signed and confirm invoice entity for routing. :party_popper:
